# Vanwayne Chaney Jr.

> AI workflow engineer in Cleveland, Ohio. Builds AI phone receptionists and workflow automation for skilled trades contractors, small law firms, and Ohio municipal government. Operates as VC2 AI LLC, which is registered in SAM.gov and can contract directly with federal, state, and local government.

Anyone can call the AI receptionist he built and talk to it: **216-616-1364**. It answers, runs a live demo for the caller's own trade, and takes a callback. That is the product demonstrating itself.

## What he actually does

- **AI phone receptionist** for businesses that lose money to missed calls. Answers every call around the clock, qualifies the caller, books the job, and texts the owner. Built for HVAC, plumbing, septic, locksmith, restoration, fencing, and water treatment.
- **Missed-call text-back** so a call that goes unanswered gets an immediate text instead of becoming a lost lead.
- **Workflow automation** — review requests, lead form follow-up, estimate recovery, invoice chasing, owner alerts.
- **Municipal automation** for small Ohio villages: meeting minutes, public records request triage, ordinance notices, contractor compliance certificate tracking.
- **AI search visibility (GEO)** for professional service firms whose sites are technically invisible to AI assistants.

## Who he works with

Skilled trades contractors, solo and small law firms, and small Ohio municipalities. The common thread is a business that loses real money between the moment someone reaches out and the moment a human responds.

## Credentials and standing

- **VC2 AI LLC**, Ohio limited liability company
- **Registered in SAM.gov** — federally registered and able to hold government contracts directly. Most solo shops never complete this.
- **Ohio Bureau of Workers' Compensation** policy active
- **RITA** business registration complete
- **A2P 10DLC** messaging campaign approved with carriers, so text automation is compliant rather than improvised
- Software developer by trade. Computer engineering degree. MBA candidate, Cleveland State University.

## How he prices

Flat fees and flat monthly retainers. Never hourly, never a percentage of revenue, never a share of a client's fees. For regulated professions such as law, revenue sharing with a non-lawyer is prohibited, and the flat structure exists so the arrangement is clean everywhere.

## Related work

- [Where the Asbestos Actually Was](https://asbestos-exposure-map.pages.dev/): an original dataset built from forty years of federal OSHA workplace air sampling, 1984 to 2023. 73,373 asbestos samples, 25,286 confirmed detections, 12,554 employers, 5,459 ZIP codes, mapped by state and named workplace. Built to help asbestos litigators establish where exposure actually occurred.
